name: Uply — Scroll to Top, Progress Bar & Read Time
author: sumuraka

sections.description:
Uply is a lightweight and powerful plugin designed to improve user experience on your WordPress site. It combines three essential features into one easy-to-use plugin:

  1. Scroll to Top Button: Help users navigate long pages easily.
  2. Reading Progress Bar: Visual indicator of how much content is left.
  3. Read Time: Automatically calculate and display estimated reading time.

Key Features:

  • Scroll to Top:
    • Customizable position (Left/Right).
    • Mobile visibility control.
    • Exclude specific pages or post types.
  • Progress Bar:
    • Position at Top or Bottom.
    • Customizable color and height.
    • Post type and page exclusion support.
  • Read Time:
    • Adjustable reading speed (Words Per Minute).
    • Custom prefix/postfix labels.
    • Automatically injected into selected post types.
  • Modern Admin Interface:
    • Deeply integrated with a clean, tabbed settings page.
    • Real-time settings saving with AJAX.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/uply-scroll-to-top-and-progress-bar directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Uply menu in the dashboard to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Can I hide the Scroll to Top button on mobile?

Yes, there is a setting to toggle visibility on mobile devices.

How is the read time calculated?

It is based on the word count of the post content divided by the reading speed (default 200 words per minute), which you can customize.
